name: Lucetta A Elmer

bio.statement: Elmer's pamphlet statement lists her occupation as State Representative and small business owner.
bio.excerpt: Occupation: State Representative; Small Business Owner

source.publisher: Oregon Voters' Pamphlet, General Election 2026 (Book 9), p. 39

bio.statement: Her pamphlet statement lists prior governmental experience as State Representative, House District 24, 2022 to present.
bio.excerpt: Prior Governmental Experience: State Representative, House District 24 (2022-Present)

source.publisher: Oregon Voters' Pamphlet, General Election 2026 (Book 9), p. 39

bio.statement: Her official page says she has lived in the district her whole life and describes serving House District 24 as an honor.
bio.excerpt: I have lived in this district my whole life, and will work hard to be a voice for our community in Salem.

bio.statement: Her official page lists her in the House leadership menu as Republican Leader.

positions.statement: Elmer's pamphlet statement says young families should not have to leave Oregon to find an affordable home.
positions.excerpt: Young families shouldn’t have to leave Oregon to find an affordable home.

source.publisher: Oregon Voters' Pamphlet, General Election 2026 (Book 9), p. 39

positions.statement: Elmer says workers should not fear layoffs because an employer decided it costs too much to operate in Oregon.
positions.excerpt: Workers shouldn’t have to be afraid of getting laid off because their employer decided it costs too much to operate here in Oregon.

source.publisher: Oregon Voters' Pamphlet, General Election 2026 (Book 9), p. 39

positions.statement: Elmer says that before asking Oregonians for more, government needs to do a better job with what it already has.
positions.excerpt: Before asking Oregonians for more, government needs to do a better job with what it already has.

source.publisher: Oregon Voters' Pamphlet, General Election 2026 (Book 9), p. 39

positions.statement: Elmer says she will continue fighting for high standards, accountability and reforms that put student success first.
positions.excerpt: I will continue fighting for high standards, accountability, and real reforms that put student success first.

source.publisher: Oregon Voters' Pamphlet, General Election 2026 (Book 9), p. 39
